name: delete_project
description:
Soft-delete a ChatCut project the signed-in user owns — the same delete the editor dashboard performs. The project disappears from the dashboard and list_projects and its edits are blocked, but its data is retained: restore_project(projectId) undoes this.

Requires an explicit projectId — destructive actions never default to the currently targeted project. If you delete the project this session was targeting, call list_projects and target_project (or create_project) before further edits.

projectId.description: Full UUID or unique 10-hex project ID to delete, from list_projects or the editor URL. Required — this tool never falls back to the targeted project.
